correctness.rationale: The Brownian transform exp(-distance sqrt(u/D)) and Poisson attempt renewal give the full objective. Strict exponential chord convexity reduces all Borel laws to endpoints; strictly convex mean objective yields exact unique clipped optimizer and thresholds; strictly concave discounted objective yields unique θ_s; Jensen and cosh bounds yield all-s symmetric and worst-target optimality. A stand-alone numerical checker passed 160 parameter choices and 40000 exact-cycle simulations; only proof establishes infinite-domain results.

value.rationale: Unknown target locations with constrained reset sites pose a natural experimentally meaningful measure-design problem. The theorem resolves the minimal symmetric two-target prior exactly for all admissible laws, gives sharp bias-phase transitions, a unique minimax design, and stronger all-discount Laplace ordering, not merely numerical or known-table behavior.
